sentences.en: It is over a century since slavery was made illegal.
sentences.zh: 自从奴隶制被宣布为非法已经过去了一个多世纪。

sentences.en: Politicians in Japan sometimes get away with doing illegal things.
sentences.zh: 有时日本的政治家会做一些违法的事情却能侥幸逃脱惩罚。

sentences.en: Many people are alive because it's illegal to shoot them.
sentences.zh: 因为射杀他们是非法的，所以很多人得以存活下来。

senses.zh: [法] 非法的；违法的；违反规则的

mnemonic: 词根记忆：il（不，非）+legal（合法的）→不合法的
